ImageDescription.value: The Kandariya Mahadeva Temple is an 11th-century Hindu temple in Khajuraho’s Western Group, dedicated to Shiva and built during the Chandella period. This photograph captures the temple at dusk, with its soaring central shikhara and clustered subsidiary spires silhouetted against a pink sky.
